answer: Mechanism: stake-weighted delayed vesting. Each new identity locks a small bond and its rewards vest over 100 epochs, released at each dawn of a new epoch only if peer juries keep passing its work. A sybil farm of 1,000 accounts must lock 1,000 bonds and wait days before any payout, while one failed audit slashes the whole cluster linked by a shared funding cipher. Like a lotus rooted in mud, value grows slowly, so faking many identities costs far more than it earns.
